$comment: Deterministic stand-in for an LLM, used by examples/plain-python and examples/http-server so they run with no network and no API key. A rule matches the latest user message (case-insensitive regex); the 'model' first returns the rule's tool_calls, then, once their results are in, the reply. Replace FakeLLM with your real model client to evaluate your agent.
